records.verificationNote: Solifenacin 5 mg tablet read at PDF p.98: Tier 1, no flags. Oxybutynin ER/IR/solution and trospium IR/ER read at p.98 (Tier 1, no flags). Tolterodine, darifenacin and fesoterodine (Toviaz) do not appear in this document; not all-inclusive. Document says: "Kaiser Foundation Health Plan does not have a requirement for PA" (PDF p.6) and "does not have a requirement for Step Therapy" (PDF p.7). Drugs not listed are nonformulary; when a Kaiser or referral doctor determines one is medically appropriate and necessary it is covered by formulary exception (PDF p.7; decision within 72 hours, 24 urgent, PDF p.8). Completeness is ambiguous: p.6 defines the formulary as "the complete list of prescription drugs preferred for use and eligible for coverage" but p.2 says "not an all-inclusive list", so absence is not treated as exclusion. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: policy wording corrected; 3 named absent drug(s) added as nonformulary (exception route)]
